name: Happy Merry Party!
source:
It's Muscatt's birthday! The mansion is decorated, the best bards in town will make the party lively, and the servants will stock the table with food and wine. 

This time, it's even more special: Muscatt's dad promised to let him embark on his journey across the land and enjoy his so long desired freedom.

But before that, it seems there are some pretty cute guests around, so what about enjoying the party to its fullest? 

[From [url=https://lazypolarbear.itch.io/happymerryparty]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
今天是穆斯卡特的生日！宅邸已装点一新，城里最好的吟游诗人将为宴会助兴，仆人们也会在餐桌上摆满美酒佳肴。

这次生日格外特别：穆斯卡特的父亲答应让他踏上游历各地的旅程，享受向往已久的自由。

不过在那之前，宴会上似乎来了几位相当可爱的客人，不如先尽情享受这场派对吧？

[摘自[url=https://lazypolarbear.itch.io/happymerryparty]itch.io[/url]]
